Privacy Policy

This policy describes data handling in the current release of 2048Pai. It is based only on the reviewed app code, Android/iOS configuration, and dependencies; planned features are not represented as live capabilities.

Scope and publisher

This policy applies to the 2048Pai mobile app. The publisher is DagoodPai; privacy questions may be sent to the public contact email shown on this page.

Current data handling

The current release has no account creation, sign-in, or authentication and does not ask for a name, email address, telephone number, or payment information.

Game score, best score, and language selection are held in application memory only for display and game logic while the app is running. The reviewed code does not use persistent preferences, a database, or cloud storage, so the app does not retain these values after it is closed or terminated.

The current release does not implement server communications, file or photo uploads, advertising, analytics, crash reporting, or in-app purchases. Flutter is used to run the interface; no other third-party SDK dependency was found.

Permissions and network

The Android release manifest declares no camera, microphone, location, contacts, storage, notification, or internet permission. The iOS configuration contains no purpose strings for photos, camera, microphone, location, or similar access. Internet permission appears only in Android debug/profile manifests for Flutter development and debugging, not in the release manifest.

The app does not send data to our servers or to third parties. Accordingly, the current release has no app-controlled server-side data-retention period.

Sharing, retention, and deletion

The current release does not sell, rent, share, or otherwise disclose user data to third parties. Because it creates no account, uploads no data, and maintains no server-side user profile, there is no account-deletion or server-side data-deletion process for this release.

In-memory data disappears when the app process ends. You can end the app at any time to clear that runtime state. If a future release adds persistence, accounts, network services, or a third-party SDK, we will update this policy, in-app disclosures, and any required consent before enabling it.

Children

The current release does not knowingly collect personal information. If you believe a child has provided us personal information, contact us through the published contact on this page and we will address the request as required by applicable law.

Changes and contact

We may update this policy when data practices change. The updated version will show a new effective date. Direct privacy questions or access/deletion requests to the public contact email shown on this page.

Effective date: 2026-10-13

Publisher: DagoodPai
